sn22.56:1.7: To the gods and humans I announced my supreme perfect awakening.
sn22.56:7.1: Whatever ascetics and brahmins have directly known feeling in this way—and its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation—and are practicing for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding feeling: they are practicing well.
sn22.56:7.2: Those who practice well have a footing in this teaching and training.
sn22.56:8.1: Those ascetics and brahmins who have directly known feeling in this way … have directly known the practice that leads to the cessation of feeling …
sn22.56:8.2: There is no cycle of rebirths to be found.
sn22.56:9.9: There is no cycle of rebirths to be found.
sn22.56:11.1: Whatever ascetics and brahmins have directly known choices in this way—and its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation—and are practicing for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding choices: they are practicing well.
sn22.56:11.2: Those who practice well have a footing in this teaching and training.
sn22.56:12.1: Those ascetics and brahmins who have directly known choices in this way—and its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation—and due to disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding choices, are freed by not grasping: they are well freed.
sn22.56:12.2: Those who are well freed are consummate ones.
sn22.56:12.3: For consummate ones, there is no cycle of rebirths to be found.
